sd-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
sd-county-officials.why: No statewide list of South Dakota's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
sd-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

sd-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app names the mayor and council of South Dakota's 3 cities of 25,000 people or more, and not those of its smaller cities or its towns.
sd-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of South Dakota's city and town officials has been read for this app. The 3 are read from each city's own pages, and the smaller places' pages have not been read one by one.
sd-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of every city's and town's mayor, council or town board, kept current, that says which seats each ward elects and which the whole city elects.

sd-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
sd-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of South Dakota's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
sd-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

sd-township-officers.summary: Where a township has a government of its own, the Township or City card says so and does not name its officers.
sd-township-officers.why: No list of South Dakota's township officers has been read for this app yet, statewide or county by county.
sd-township-officers.wanted: A statewide list of township officers, or each county's or township's own published list of them.

sd-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website. It names the Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community's council, and not yet the other eleven nations' councils.
sd-tribal-government.why: This app has not read the council lists of South Dakota's other eleven nations yet. Each nation publishes its own, which has to be read one nation at a time.
sd-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, read one nation at a time.
